feeds.title: New Mexico Politics with Joe Monahan
feeds.description: Welcome to my site where you will keep up on the latest political developments in New Mexico. I am Joe Monahan, a veteran political analyst, consultant and political journalist. We are not affiliated with any political party and cover all aspects of state politics. Join us at the home of New Mexico politics for news, analysis, comment & humor.

feeds.title: New Mexico Political Report
feeds.description: NM Political Report is New Mexico's largest news online outlet covering politics and elections. As a not-for-profit outlet. It is the best political reporting for New Mexico.

feeds.title: New Mexico In Depth
feeds.description: A New Mexico news organization dedicated to fostering, promoting and publishing journalism in the public interest. It covers topics such as money in politics, good governance, criminal justice, child welfare, and environment.

feeds.title: Conservation Voters New Mexico
feeds.description: Conservation Voters, New Mexico's mission is to connect the people of New Mexico to their political power to ensure ecological health and social equity and protect our quality of life.

feeds.title: New Mexico Voices for Children Blog
feeds.description: NMVoices is a nonpartisan, statewide advocacy org working to create systems-level sustainable change that will improve the lives of NM children.

feeds.title: ProgressNow New Mexico Blog
feeds.description: ProgressNow New Mexico centers justice for systemically excluded communities, building political power through partnerships, trusted communications & campaigns.

feeds.title: New Mexico News Port
feeds.description: Journalism and Innovation from The University of New Mexico publishing real stories for real New Mexicans. In April 2014, our idea to start a news lab at the University of New Mexico won a grant from the Online News Association as part of the Challenge Fund for Innovation in Journalism Education.

feeds.title: Santa Fe New Mexican Election
feeds.description: Santa Fe's locally owned and operated news source, covering news, sports, arts, science, and politics. Covers articles on Election news and updates.

feeds.title: KRQE News 13 Politics
feeds.description: Providing the latest news and accurate weather forecasts from Albuquerque to across the state of New Mexico. Covers articles on Political updates and news.

feeds.title: Searchlight New Mexico Politics
feeds.description: Nonprofit and nonpartisan investigative news focused on the issues that impact the people of New Mexico. It Covers political updates and news.

feeds.title: New Mexico Political Journal
feeds.description: New Mexico Political Journal offers political news and analysis of New Mexico's government and politics. The primary purpose of the New Mexico Political Journal is to educate the people of New Mexico at large and the electorate in particular regarding the history, demography, and culture of New Mexico, as well as its electoral and political landscape.

feeds.title: New Mexico Black Leadership Council Blog
feeds.description: The New Mexico Black Leadership Council catalyzes a vibrant social profit sector for Black/African American communities. Committed to accountability and transparency, they prioritize ethical practices in serving New Mexico's Black community. Partnering with donors and sponsors, ensures contributions are utilized openly and transparently.

feeds.title: New Mexico Democrats
feeds.description: The Democratic Party of New Mexico--Building a future for all New Mexico families.
